notes: Single-request diagnostics; capacities and warmup histories differ.
Q8 candidates ran API checks before retrieval; frozen F32 ran a short warmup.
Earlier native probes in scalar/FP32-BLAS modes were stopped for tuning after their 62K checks; no native-length pass is attributed to those runs.

issues_detected.resolution: Keep the FP32 guard and default precision; validate the explicit opt-in rounding contract separately.

issues_detected.check: Q8 MTP vs ordinary JSON output
issues_detected.resolution: Align recurrent prefill reduction, matrix reduction templates and activation precision for small projections.
Trace the first decode step and align Q4/Q5 and small Q6 projection paths; all 129 traced prefill/block-boundary row checksums then match.

issues_detected.initial_result: missing ROCm pair-kernel symbol before generation
issues_detected.resolution: Move the entry point into the ROCm implementation block; validate all new entry points before model acceptance.

issues_detected.initial_result: Markdown table delimiter was misclassified as repeated tokens
issues_detected.resolution: Exclude a valid delimiter only after a matching textual header in the token-pattern heuristic; preserve raw control-token and repeated-line checks. Regression fixtures expose the original false positive and retain malformed/repeated cases.

limitations: Synthetic near-native key retrieval does not measure long-document comprehension or repository coding acceptance.
The earlier reviewed repository feature used a 32768-token F32 configuration.
Q8 KV is lossy; FP16-input attention adds a separate opt-in precision change.
Kernel error statistics describe the sampled inputs, not a global accuracy bound.
CUDA hardware, other model families and multi-slot Q8 serving are outside this validation.
